title: ctenitis magna
intro: Ctenitis magna, commonly known as the large tree fern, is a plant species in the family Dryopteridaceae. It is traditionally used in various cultures for its medicinal properties, which include promoting wound healing, reducing inflammation, and soothing digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Ctenitis magna are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenes, phenolic compounds, and flavonoids, which are responsible for its medicinal effects.
